As a family-owned enterprise, Scheidt & Bachmann values trust, reliability, and community, fostering a corporate culture that emphasizes collaboration, integrity, and forward-thinking. The company's commitment to quality and innovation has established it as a trusted partner worldwide, connecting people and goods efficiently and safely. By continuously advancing its technology and digital solutions, Scheidt & Bachmann aims to shape the future of mobility and transportation, ensuring sustainable and seamless experiences for millions of users daily.

This full-time, permanent position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the digital transformation of our industrial applications within the operational technology division. Your role will involve designing and implementing integrations between various enterprise systems, such as ERP, production, warehousing, and third-party platforms. Completed education or degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a comparable technical field.
Extensive experience in software development using C# and the .NET framework.
Proficiency in database management, particularly with Oracle and MS SQL Server.
Hands-on experience with APIs, web services, and system integrations.
Understanding of manufacturing, logistics, and business processes.
Excellent proficiency in German; good command of English; valid work authorization for the EU.
Ability to work independently and responsibly, combined with strong communication skills and team orientation.

Participate actively in shaping the digital future of our production environment by developing and modernizing applications for manufacturing and logistics.
Design and implement practical software solutions tailored for real-world application, ensuring usability and efficiency.
Create and maintain integrations between ERP systems, production platforms, warehouse management, and third-party systems, ensuring seamless data flow.
Translate complex technical and business requirements into sustainable software architectures and solutions.
Expand and enhance our API and integration landscape to support scalable and flexible system communication.
Evaluate emerging technologies and digital trends, providing innovative ideas and driving digital transformation initiatives.
Serve as a technical point of contact for internal teams and departments, facilitating knowledge sharing and collaboration to optimize production digitalization efforts.

Secure employment with a permanent contract in an innovative, stable, and established company that values diversity and equality.
Flexible work arrangements including flexible working hours, home-office options, and part-time work to support work-life balance.

Company Description

Rasēd is a cutting-edge fraud detection and prevention solution designed for financial institutions, fintechs, and payment providers. It combines AI, device intelligence, and behavioral biometrics to detect and prevent fraud in real time while ensuring a seamless user experience. The platform also includes advanced analytics for post-incident investigation, compliance, and automated case management, enabling faster, smarter, and more secure fraud management.

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (Onsite)
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Purpose

The Software Engineer will design, build, and maintain scalable services and platforms that power Rasēd’s fraud‑detection, transaction‑monitoring, and risk‑decisioning products in a regulated financial environment. 

Key Responsabilities

● Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs that power Rasēd’s fraud‑detection, transaction‑monitoring, and risk‑scoring workflows.
● Implement reliable, testable, and scalable code (e.g.Java, .NET) following modern software development practices and code review standards.
● Work closely with data science, product, and compliance teams to translate fraud models, AML/KYC rules, and risk policies into production‑ready services and decision engines.
● Design and maintain data architectures (data pipelines, databases, messaging systems) to support high‑volume financial transactions and fraud analytics.
● Integrate third‑party AML/KYC, sanctions screening, and fraud platforms or internal risk tools into Rasēd’s ecosystem.
● Build monitoring, logging, and alerting for fraud‑related services to ensure high availability, observability, and fast incident response.
● Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and architecture decisions, contributing to continuous improvement of Rasēd’s platform.
● Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to understand requirements, deliver technical solutions, and support deployments in production environments.
● Stay current with new technologies in fraud detection, AI/ML, and software engineering, and propose improvements to Rasēd’s products and engineering practices. 

Qualifications & Competencies

● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field ● 2–5+ years of professional software development experience Strong programming skills in at least one modern backend language (e.g., Java, .NET), with experience building RESTful APIs or microservices.
● Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modeling, and performance optimization for high‑volume systems.
● Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP or OCI), containers (Docker), and orchestration tools (Kubernetes), plus CI/CD pipelines.
● Familiarity with building data‑driven or AI‑enabled applications (rules engines, scoring systems, anomaly detection) is highly desirable in fraud and risk contexts.
● Solid understanding of software engineering best practices: testing, version control (Git), documentation, and secure coding.
